records.text: Candace Owens said Donald Trump had lost support from the Make America Healthy Again movement, Megyn Kelly, Alex Jones, an unintelligible named commentator, and others over his Middle East policy.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Everybody is telling you that you've lost a large portion of your base. You have lost MAHA. You've lost Megyn Kelly. ... You've lost [unintelligible name]. You've lost Alex Jones. You've lost—and that's just in terms of the commentariat, if you will.

verification.notes: Current reporting confirms an open break over the Iran war between Trump and Megyn Kelly, Candace Owens, Alex Jones, Tucker Carlson, and other prominent right-wing figures. Evidence supports a meaningful media-base fracture, but lost MAHA and lost a large portion of the base are broader claims not established by the cited reporting or polling.

sources.title: Trump blasts MAGA influencers who have split with him over Iran
sources.relevance: Confirms that Kelly, Owens, Jones, Carlson and other former allies publicly opposed Trump over the Iran war.
